updated: "2026-04-21T00:00:00Z"
---

# Use SQLite

## Context

We need a search solution.

## Decision

Use SQLite with FTS5.

## Consequences

Fast full-text search.
-- valid-adr.md --

We decided something.

-- append-content.md --

-- append-content.md --

-- custom-template.yaml --
name: custom
description: Custom template for testing
dir: custom
schema:
  frontmatter:
    title:
      type: string
      required: true
    type:
      type: string
      required: true
    status:
      type: string
      required: true
      enum:
        - active
        - inactive
validations:
  - id: has_heading
    rule: 'page.ast.headings.exists(h, h.level == 1)'
    requirement: Must have an H1 heading
    expect: page must have an H1 heading
lint_rules:
  - id: custom_stale
    rule: 'now > timestamp("2000-01-01T00:00:00Z")'
    severity: warning
    expect: Clock is working
-- custom-template.yaml --

-- custom-pass.md --
---
type: custom
title: Valid Custom
status: active
---

# Heading

Content here.
-- custom-pass.md --

-- custom-fail.md --
---
type: custom
title: Invalid Custom
status: active
---

No heading here, just plain text.
-- custom-fail.md --

-- unsatisfiable-template.yaml --
name: bad
description: Template with unsatisfiable rule
dir: bad
schema:
  frontmatter:
    title:
      type: string
      required: true
    type:
      type: string
      required: true
validations:
  - id: always_fails
    rule: 'page.frontmatter.title == ""'
    requirement: Title must be empty
    expect: title must be empty
-- unsatisfiable-template.yaml --

-- unsatisfiable-pass.md --
---
type: bad
title: Has Title
---

# Heading
-- unsatisfiable-pass.md --

-- unsatisfiable-fail.md --
---
type: bad
title: Also Has Title
---

# Heading
-- unsatisfiable-fail.md --

# ============================================================
# Section 1: Write validation success
# ============================================================

exec akb init cel-kb
cd cel-kb

exec akb write adr/use-sqlite.md <../valid-adr.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/use-sqlite.md'

# ============================================================
# Section 2: Write validation failure (missing Context heading)
# ============================================================

! exec akb write adr/missing-context.md <../invalid-adr.md
stderr 'require_context'
stderr 'page must have a .## Context. heading'

# ============================================================
# Section 3: --append validation (append to valid page)
# ============================================================

exec akb write adr/use-sqlite.md --append <../append-content.md
stdout 'Appended to kb/decisions/use-sqlite.md'

# ============================================================
# Section 4: --frontmatter validation with old_page
# ============================================================

! exec akb write --frontmatter status=invalid decisions/use-sqlite.md
stderr 'valid_status'
stderr 'status must be one of proposed, accepted, deprecated, superseded'

# ============================================================
# Section 5: template get adr returns Writer View
# ============================================================

exec akb template get adr
stdout 'name: adr'
stdout 'description: Architecture Decision Record'
stdout 'requirements:'
stdout 'Must include H2 .Context. section'

# ============================================================
# Section 6: template get adr --example returns pass mockup
# ============================================================

exec akb template get adr --example
stdout 'type: adr'
stdout '## Context'

# ============================================================
# Section 7: template get adr --full returns complete YAML
# ============================================================

exec akb template get adr --full
stdout 'name: adr'
stdout 'validations:'
stdout 'lint_rules:'
stdout 'require_context'
stdout 'adr_stale'

# ============================================================
# Section 8: template write accepts valid template + mockups
# ============================================================

exec akb template write custom --template ../custom-template.yaml --pass ../custom-pass.md --fail ../custom-fail.md
stdout 'Template .custom. written'

# Verify the template was written
exists .akb/templates/custom.yaml
exists .akb/templates/custom_pass.md
exists .akb/templates/custom_fail.md

# ============================================================
# Section 9: template write rejects unsatisfiable rules
# ============================================================

! exec akb template write bad --template ../unsatisfiable-template.yaml --pass ../unsatisfiable-pass.md --fail ../unsatisfiable-fail.md
stderr 'pass mockup: validation\(s\) failed'
